title: Camel (and Sentence) pattern treats a leading empty word as the first word
property: with the Camel pattern, the first non-empty word is lowercased and the remaining words are capitalized, even if the input has leading delimiters
actual: "AA" (the empty leading word consumes the 'first word' slot, so the real first word is capitalized)
evidence: Pattern::Camel doc: 'Makes the first non-empty word lowercase and the remaining capitalized.' Pattern::Sentence doc says the same for 'first non-empty word capitalized' (convert("_a_a") with Snake->Sentence gives " a a" instead of " A a"). Pattern::mutate uses index i == 0 instead of the first non-empty word.
